acceptance_criteria: All documented closing keyword forms, tense and case variants, optional colons, and same- or cross-repository targets have positive directive coverage.
Negated and disclaimer-shaped closing directives fail before a default-branch merge.
Intentional directives pass only through a declared machine-readable policy that reports bounded issue numbers.
Plain references and neutral issue URLs are not treated as closing directives.
Pull-request body and candidate commit enforcement use one parser and fail closed on unavailable, malformed, empty, or truncated metadata.
Default-branch candidates fail hard and stacked candidates receive a visible retargeting warning.
Diagnostics contain only bounded rule codes, counts, pull-request numbers, and issue numbers.
Existing publication, repository-hygiene, pre-push, merge-group, and quality suites remain green.

falsifier_or_remaining_gap: A shared current detector would falsify the finding only if the historical negated-directive fixture failed through pull-request-body and candidate-commit enforcement and missing or truncated metadata failed closed. No such detector exists at the pin. This record-only audit did not publish a synthetic pull request or mutate issue lifecycle state.
impact: A grammatically negative disclaimer can be interpreted by GitHub as an issue-closing directive when a pull request reaches the default branch, mutating planning state despite source and test gates passing.
lead_verification_obligations: Approve the intentional-directive policy, default-branch rule, stacked-branch warning, commit-range definition, merge-group behavior, and missing-metadata taxonomy before implementation.
Run one forthcoming single stable complete open-pull-request census before assigning an implementation owner or recording overlaps.

Require RED and GREEN coverage for the historical lifecycle fixture, all supported keywords, disclaimer variants, intentional closure, neutral references, retargeting, unavailable metadata, API failure, and empty or malformed candidate ranges.
Verify pull-request CI uses least privilege and never executes untrusted code through a pull_request_target checkout.
Keep issue closure, pull-request retargeting, merge, branch-protection mutation, and external lifecycle canaries outside the draft implementation work.
